china-1913:p0713_1.rationale: Import duty schedule for iron, steel and other metal goods by tariff unit and rate; this is a tariff rate schedule.

china-1913:p0714_1.rationale: Continuation of the import tariff schedule covering metals, condensed milk, mineral waters, morphia, musk, needles and oils, with duty rates per unit.

china-1913:p0715_1.rationale: Import tariff rates for oils, opium, paper, pepper, plushes and other articles. Opium appears only as one row among many, so the table is not substantially about narcotics.

china-1913:p0716_1.rationale: Tariff schedule of duty per unit or ad valorem for miscellaneous articles from pork rind to sherry.

china-1913:p0717_1.rationale: Import duty rates for shoes, silk goods, soaps, sodas, sugar and other articles.

china-1913:p0718_1.rationale: Import duty schedule for sugar, sulphur, thread, timber, tobacco and tools, with units and rates.

china-1913:p0719_1.rationale: Tariff rates for files, umbrellas, waxes, wines and other miscellaneous articles.

china-1913:p0720_1.rationale: Import duty rates for wines, spirits, beers and woods by unit.

china-1913:p0721_1.rationale: Import tariff rates for woods and woollen and cotton goods, by unit and duty.

china-1913:p0722_1.rationale: Final page of the tariff schedule, listing duties on woollen, cotton and other yarns and related articles.
